name: trimerge-pro-career
description: TriMergePRO Careers monorepo: apps/api (Express), apps/web (Next.js), e2e (Playwright). Each app keeps its own lockfile (see docs/repository-restructure.md).

scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix apps/api && npm ci --prefix apps/web && npm ci --prefix e2e
scripts.typecheck: npx --prefix apps/api tsc -p apps/api --noEmit && npx --prefix apps/web tsc -p apps/web --noEmit
